arg.name: race
arg.description: Load the slim RACE-TIME config (config/pitwall_race.rviz, 7 subscriptions) instead of the full one (25). Every enabled display is a topic the CAR has to serialise and push over WiFi, and a connected pitwall was enough to starve the control loop -- the car lagged, stopped and hit a wall while a 15-minute run with pitwall closed was clean. Use race:=true while the car is DRIVING; the full config is for a stationary car in the pits.

arg.name: rviz_config
arg.description: RViz config to load (overrides the race/full choice above)
